title: Aircraft Mishap Response Actions

nodes.text: Extricate injured occupants and extinguish fires

evidence.source_text: Do whatever is necessary to extricate injured occupants and to extinguish fires.

nodes.text: Document and/or photograph location of debris disturbed for rescue/fire suppression

evidence.source_text: Document and/or photograph the location of any debris that must be disturbed in order to carry out rescue and/or fire suppression activities.

nodes.text: Identify witnesses and get contact information

evidence.source_text: Identify witnesses and get contact information.

nodes.text: Exercise site safety precautions: use protective devices/clothing, exercise caution

evidence.source_text: It’s important to exercise good judgment, use available protective devices and clothing, and use extreme caution when working in the wreckage.
Time is extremely critical when responding to an emergency. Immediate positive action is necessary; delay may affect someone’s survival.
